_comment: Curated subset of EWRAM addresses for Pokemon Feuerrote (German Fire Red), sourced from Ironmon-Tracker's Pokemon Feuerrote.json (MIT licensed). EWRAM (02xxxxxx) addresses are identical across all language versions of a game per GameSettings.lua's documented invariant, so these are used directly without RAM-search discovery. RomHeader values are used as a startup sanity check to confirm the loaded ROM matches this table.
